rows.note: Use this colloquial word when police arrest or take someone into custody.

example.english: I watched the police apprehend a wanted criminal yesterday.
example.traditional: 我噚日睇住警察拉咗個通緝犯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 tai2 zyu6 ging2 caat3 laai1 zo2 go3 tung1 cap1 faan2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for understanding or grasping an idea.

example.english: I now apprehend why you made that choice.
example.traditional: 而家我明白你點解作出呢個選擇喇。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 dim2 gaai2 zok3 ceot1 ni1 go3 syun2 zaak6 laa3
